lines: I have now memorized the carpet.
The plant and I are on a first-name basis.
I dressed up for this chair.
Is this a waiting room or a patience audition?
If waiting were a sport, I'd have a trophy.
That robot has better posture than me.
My calendar just filed a complaint.
Does this queue come with loyalty points?
At least my pixel hair is behaving.
The magazine is older than my passwords.
This chair and I are getting pretty serious.
Someone give that plant employee of the month.
I see the robot skipped leg day.
The Wi-Fi and I are both searching for a connection.
My other appointment is with a sandwich.
This room really commits to the waiting part.
They said take a seat. Apparently, it's a long-term commitment.
I'm starting to see why they call us patients.
My appointment was at two. They didn't specify which day.
That plant is plastic. Even it couldn't survive the wait.
I'd ask for a second opinion, but I'd probably need a second appointment.
I've been here so long, I'm eligible for staff parking.
The receptionist said 'just a minute.' Bold use of the word 'minute.'
If they call my name, act surprised. I want to feel famous.
